topic: A session can hide what it ran by flooding its own queue share
detail: Each harness process may hold a quarter of the command log's queue; once it is full its further events are dropped and only a gap record with the count remains. Accepted while the guard only logs (D-30); SP-041 fails closed when enforcing, so a refused call is still decided. Confirm, or decide whether refusals and guard decisions must never be dropped.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: refusals and guard decisions are never dropped; see D-37 and SP-041.1.a4.
